statement.ru: Ламантины — «морские коровы» — питаются рыбой.
statement.en: Manatees, the 'sea cows', feed on fish.

why: Manatees are herbivores eating sea grasses and water plants.

statement.ru: Далёкие предки китов ходили по суше на четырёх ногах.
statement.en: The distant ancestors of whales walked on land on four legs.

why: Early cetaceans like Pakicetus had four functional legs and lived on land and in shallows.

statement.ru: Жемчужина почти всегда вырастает вокруг песчинки.
statement.en: A pearl almost always grows around a grain of sand.

why: Wikipedia: the grain-of-sand belief is rarely the case; parasites or tissue damage are typical.

statement.ru: Тупик может нести в клюве больше десятка рыбок сразу.
statement.en: A puffin can carry more than a dozen small fish in its beak at once.

why: Puffins hold several, sometimes over a dozen, fish crosswise in the bill.

statement.ru: Чёрный жемчуг получают, только окрашивая белый.
statement.en: Black pearls are only made by dyeing white ones.

why: Tahitian pearls from black-lip oysters are naturally dark.

statement.ru: Кальмар-вампир питается кровью рыб.
statement.en: The vampire squid feeds on the blood of fish.

why: It feeds on detritus (marine snow), not blood.

statement.ru: Кашалоты спят, зависнув в воде вертикально.
statement.en: Sperm whales sleep hanging upright in the water.

why: Pods sleep briefly in a vertical position near the surface.

statement.ru: Коралл белеет, когда из него уходят живущие в нём водоросли.
statement.en: A coral turns white when the algae living inside it leave.

why: Bleaching is the loss of zooxanthellae algae from coral tissue.

statement.ru: Есть креветка, которая оглушает добычу щелчком клешни.
statement.en: There is a shrimp that stuns its prey with a snap of its claw.

why: Snapping shrimp shoot a bubble-jet 'shot' from the claw that stuns prey.

statement.ru: Полярная крачка круглый год живёт в Арктике.
statement.en: The Arctic tern lives in the Arctic all year round.

why: It flies from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back every year.

statement.ru: Морской конёк плавает быстрее большинства рыб.
statement.en: A seahorse swims faster than most fish.

why: Seahorses are among the slowest swimmers; the dwarf seahorse, slowest fish of all, tops out at 1.5 m an hour.

statement.ru: Из одного оторванного луча может вырасти целая морская звезда.
statement.en: A whole new starfish can grow from a single torn-off arm.

why: Some starfish regrow a complete disc and body from a single arm ('comet' form).

statement.ru: Морж вытаскивает себя на льдину, цепляясь бивнями.
statement.en: A walrus hauls itself onto the ice using its tusks.

why: Tusks help it climb out onto ice; Odobenus means 'tooth-walker'.

statement.ru: У кубомедузы целых 24 глаза.
statement.en: A box jellyfish has 24 eyes.

why: Box jellyfish have six eyes on each of four rhopalia, 24 in all.

statement.ru: В Японии до сих пор ловят рыбу с помощью ручных бакланов.
statement.en: In Japan, people still catch fish with tame cormorants.

why: Cormorant fishing (ukai) still takes place in 13 Japanese cities, e.g. on the Nagara River.

statement.ru: Морские черепахи откладывают яйца прямо в воду.
statement.en: Sea turtles lay their eggs right in the water.

why: Females come ashore and bury eggs in sandy beaches.

statement.ru: На пляжах Южной Африки живут дикие пингвины.
statement.en: Wild penguins live on beaches in South Africa.

why: African penguins breed in southern Africa, e.g. Boulders Beach near Cape Town.

statement.ru: Зелёная черепаха названа так из-за цвета жира, а не панциря.
statement.en: The green sea turtle is named for the colour of its fat, not its shell.

why: The name refers to the green fat under its carapace.

statement.ru: Мама-осьминог умирает вскоре после того, как вылупятся её детёныши.
statement.en: A mother octopus dies soon after her eggs hatch.

why: The female guards the eggs until they hatch, after which she dies.

statement.ru: Люди — обычная добыча большой белой акулы.
statement.en: People are regular prey for the great white shark.

why: White sharks do not find humans suitable prey; most bites are curiosity or mistaken identity.

statement.ru: Детёныш синего кита рождается размером с кошку.
statement.en: A baby blue whale is born the size of a cat.

why: Newborn blue whales are 6-7 m long and weigh 2-3 t.

statement.ru: Некоторые дельфины надевают на нос губку, когда ищут еду на дне.
statement.en: Some dolphins put a sponge on their snout while searching for food on the seabed.

why: Shark Bay dolphins carry marine sponges on the rostrum to protect it while foraging.

statement.ru: Морская губка — это растение.
statement.en: A sea sponge is a plant.

why: Sponges are animals, phylum Porifera.

statement.ru: Любая акула задохнётся, если перестанет плыть.
statement.en: Any shark will suffocate if it stops swimming.

why: Most sharks pump water over their gills at rest; only a few species must keep swimming.

statement.ru: Вынырнув, дельфин вдыхает воздух ртом.
statement.en: When it surfaces, a dolphin breathes in through its mouth.

why: Dolphins breathe through the blowhole on top of the head, their real nose.

statement.ru: Есть рыба с прозрачной головой, сквозь которую видны её глаза.
statement.en: There is a fish with a see-through head, and you can see its eyes inside.

why: Barreleyes have eyes inside a large transparent dome of soft tissue.

statement.ru: Португальский кораблик — это одна большая медуза.
statement.en: A Portuguese man o' war is one big jellyfish.

why: It is a siphonophore, a colony of many zooids, not a jellyfish.

statement.ru: Горбатые киты ловят рыбу в «сеть» из пузырей воздуха.
statement.en: Humpback whales catch fish in a 'net' made of air bubbles.

why: Humpbacks spiral up exhaling a wall of bubbles that corrals fish, then lunge through it.

statement.ru: Бычья акула может заплыть вверх по Амазонке на тысячи километров.
statement.en: A bull shark can swim thousands of kilometres up the Amazon.

why: Bull sharks have travelled 4,000 km up the Amazon to Iquitos, Peru.

statement.ru: Солнечный свет в океане доходит до глубины пять километров.
statement.en: Sunlight in the ocean reaches five kilometres down.

why: Sunlight fades to under 1 % by 200-800 m; below about 1-2 km it is total darkness.

statement.ru: На острове Рождества перекрывают дороги, чтобы миллионы крабов дошли до моря.
statement.en: On Christmas Island, roads are closed so that millions of crabs can reach the sea.

why: Millions of red crabs migrate to the sea to spawn; authorities close roads.

statement.ru: Самая большая рыба на свете — синий кит.
statement.en: The biggest fish in the world is the blue whale.

why: A whale is a mammal; the whale shark is the largest fish.

statement.ru: Колумб записал, что видел русалок, — скорее всего, это были ламантины.
statement.en: Columbus wrote that he had seen mermaids: most likely they were manatees.

why: On 9 Jan 1493 Columbus logged three 'mermaids', thought to be manatees.

statement.ru: Испуганная миксина за доли секунды окутывает себя облаком слизи.
statement.en: A frightened hagfish wraps itself in a cloud of slime in a split second.

why: Hagfish slime expands 10,000-fold in 0.4 s and clogs predators' gills.

statement.ru: Императорский пингвин высиживает яйцо в гнезде из камешков.
statement.en: An emperor penguin hatches its egg in a nest of pebbles.

why: No nest: the male holds the egg on his feet under a fold of skin.

statement.ru: Морской слон может нырнуть глубже двух километров.
statement.en: An elephant seal can dive more than two kilometres deep.

why: Southern elephant seals have been recorded at 2,388 m.

statement.ru: Белуха умеет подражать человеческой речи.
statement.en: A beluga whale can imitate human speech.

why: The beluga NOC mimicked the rhythm and tone of human speech.

statement.ru: Есть краб, который лазает по пальмам и вскрывает кокосы.
statement.en: There is a crab that climbs palm trees and breaks open coconuts.

why: The coconut crab climbs coconut palms and opens coconuts with its claws.

statement.ru: Пеликан носит запас рыбы в мешке под клювом.
statement.en: A pelican keeps a store of fish in the pouch under its bill.

why: Wikipedia: food is not stored in the pouch, contrary to folklore; it drains water and swallows.

statement.ru: Касатки едят только рыбу.
statement.en: Orcas eat only fish.

why: Orcas also hunt seals, whales, dolphins and sharks, even great whites.

statement.ru: Тупик, которого зовут «морским попугаем», — родственник попугаев.
statement.en: The puffin, nicknamed the 'sea parrot', is a relative of parrots.

why: Puffins are auks (Alcidae, Charadriiformes), kin of gulls, not parrots.

statement.ru: По ушной сере кита можно узнать его возраст — она слоистая, как спил дерева.
statement.en: You can tell a whale's age from its earwax: it has layers like tree rings.

why: Baleen whale earwax plugs build up in layers that are counted to age the whale, like tree rings.
